title: Nazi officials coordinate the Holocaust at Wannsee
summary: Senior Nazi and German government officials met in a villa at Wannsee, Berlin, under Reinhard Heydrich to coordinate the deportation and murder of the Jews of Europe.
reason: Mass killing was already under way, and Heydrich wanted all ministries to cooperate in what the Nazis called the Final Solution.
significance: Its minutes are among the clearest records of the Holocaust's planning.
